{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {sum(sales['customer_age'] == -1)}")

# Check the revenue column: is it really text?
print(f"Unique values in revenue (first 10): {sales['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check if any revenue values are suspiciously high
print(f"Max revenue: {sales['revenue'].max()}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {sum(sales['status'] == 'refunded')}")

# Check if revenue contains commas
print(f"Revenue sample with commas: {sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()}")"}
